title: AURIONS version 1 cognitive and operation domain payloads
description: Language-neutral payload schemas for cognitive and operation contracts. The common envelope and capability descriptor body are defined in separate canonical schemas under schemas/. These schemas describe data shape, not authorization or proof of execution.

command_type.description: Open namespaced command identifier; resolved by the receiver's versioned command registry, not a closed capability enum.

query_type.description: Open namespaced query identifier; resolved by the receiver's versioned query registry.

providerLifecycle.$comment: Provider trust lifecycle is independent of capability knowledge and never grants execution authority.

providerFailure.$comment: Typed provider/discovery failure. Unknown side effects prohibit blind retry.

revision.description: Optimistic concurrency revision; incremented exactly once for every committed task-run state transition.

taskRunTransition.description: Immutable task-run state transition. The event is appended in the same local transaction as the task_runs projection update. Runtime validation enforces revision = previous_revision + 1 and rejects no-op or illegal transitions.
